parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.part_stem: The decay of a nucleus $^{35}_{18}\text{Ar}$ by $\beta^{+}$ emission is represented by $$^{35}_{18}\text{Ar} \rightarrow X + \beta^{+} + Y.$$ A nucleus $X$ and two particles, $\beta^{+}$ and $Y$, are produced by the decay. State:
parts.text: the proton number and the nucleon number of nucleus $X$

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: the name of the particle represented by the symbol $Y$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: A hadron consists of two down quarks and one strange quark. Determine, in terms of the elementary charge $e$, the charge of this hadron.
